tha-ap36:1.1: padumuttarabuddhassa → padumuttarassa buddhassa (sya-all) | padumuttarabuddhassa → padumuttarassa (bj: PTS, the, sī.selu)
tha-ap36:4.1: kantaṁ piyaṁ → kantayidaṁ (sya-all) | piyaṁ → ciraṁ (pts) | kantaṁ → kantayidaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap36:4.4: yo → yaṁ (sya-all) | adāsidaṁ → adāsi so (sya-all) | pupphaṁ adāsidaṁ → puppham adāsi so (pts) | yo → yaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | adāsi’daṁ → adāsi so (bj: sī.selu, machasaṁ)
tha-ap36:6.1: dasa aṭṭha cakkhattuṁ → dasamaṭṭhakkhattuñca (sya-all) | so → taṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | cakkhattuṁ → dasa caṭṭhakkhattuṁ (cck: sī.); dasamaṭṭhakkhattuṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap36:9.3: gottena → nāmena (sya-all) | gottena → nāmena (cck: sī. syā. ka.)
tha-ap36:11.4: nibbāyissatināsavo paṭisambhidamanuppattaṁ → nibbāyissatanāsavo paṭisambhidā canuppattaṁ (bj) | nibbāyissatināsavo → nibbāyissatyanāsavo (sya-all)
tha-ap36:12.3: taṁ → so (bj, pts) | taṁ → so (cck: sī.)
tha-ap36:14.1: moho ca → suvimuttam me (pts) | ca → cittañca me suvimuttaṁ (bj: the, PTS)
tha-ap36:15.3: pasādito → pamodito (bj, pts) | ca → pāsādikova (bj: the) | Pasādito → pamodito (cck: sī.)
